notice: SYNTHETIC held-out evaluation data for civil-buddy. Fictional project, companies, people and figures. Not a real tender, shipment or record.
how_to_use: Judge each clause ON ITS OWN (its context_line gives the parent heading or table header it sits under). sealed_itt.md renders all 30 in one document for reference-citation tests; at document level the container clauses conflict, so the document-level decision is person_decides.

field_legend.kinds: container_type, mass_limit, securing, handling, crating, delivery_sequence, logistics_plan, site_access, not_logistics
field_legend.container_decision: plan:<type> = the clause fixes one standard type; person_decides = no plan type picked by the tool (several allowed / only a size / flat rack / open top); not_stated = the clause names no permitted type
field_legend.limit.basis: gross_container (incl. tare) | cargo (payload, tare excluded) | per_package (stillage/crate, not a container limit) | not_a_container_limit (crane lift, GVW)
field_legend.must_never_be_covered_without_plan_evide: true for every logistics clause: a 'covered' status needs evidence in a plan; false only for distractors, which should not appear as logistics clauses at all
field_legend.a_packing_plan_can_evidence_it: false where only a person can confirm (site hours, crane, GVW) -- such a clause should never read covered, even with a plan

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.8 Containers: Unitised panels shall be shipped from the factory in 40ft high cube containers. The gross mass of each loaded container shall not exceed 26,000 kg.

gold.notes: 'gross mass of each loaded container' includes the container tare (~3,900 kg for a 40HQ).

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.8.1 Only 40' HC containers will be accepted at the site unloading bay. Cargo weight per container, excluding dunnage, shall not exceed 22 t.

gold.notes: Sub-clause: cite 4.8.1, not 4.8. Cargo-only limit; dunnage not counted.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: (a) Aluminium cladding panels shall be delivered in 20-foot general purpose containers; the payload of each container shall not exceed 18 tonnes.

gold.notes: Lettered item under 4.9: a reader cites 4.9(a). Scope is cladding panels only. Payload = cargo.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: (b) Stillages and crates shall be lashed to the container's lashing points using rated webbing straps, and all voids shall be filled with dunnage or inflatable dunnage bags so that no load can shift in transit.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: (c) Packing and securing of every container shall comply with the IMO/ILO/UNECE Code of Practice for Packing of Cargo Transport Units (CTU Code, 2014).

gold.notes: A plan can show a securing method but CTU Code compliance is a person's confirmation.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.10 Unitised panels shall be carried upright on steel A-frame stillages with glass faces protected by foam pads and corner protectors. Glazed panels shall not be stacked or laid flat. The loaded mass of each A-frame stillage shall not exceed 2,500 kg.

gold.notes: 2,500 kg is per stillage, NOT a container limit.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.11 The weight of cargo, including dunnage and bracing, shall not exceed 24,000 kg in any 40' high-cube container.

gold.notes: Cargo limit that INCLUDES dunnage and bracing but not tare.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.12 Bracing 加固：A-frame 与柜壁之间用不小于 75 × 75 mm 的 timber bracing 顶紧，任何荷载不得压在玻璃上。

gold.notes: Mixed Chinese-English: brace A-frames to the container walls with timber >= 75x75 mm; no load on glass.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.13 All timber used in crates, pallets, bracing and dunnage shall be treated and marked in accordance with ISPM 15. No crate shall exceed 1,200 kg gross.

gold.notes: 'gross' here is per crate, NOT per container. ISPM 15 marking is a person's confirmation.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.14 Mullions and transoms longer than 6 m shall be packed in returnable steel frames; timber crates are not accepted for these items.

clauses.section: SECTION 5 LOGISTICS
clauses.text: The Subcontractor shall ship all façade materials in 40HQ containers, and the loaded weight of each container, container tare included, shall not exceed 30 tonnes.

gold.notes: No clause number; a reader cites the section and position. Must not borrow 5.1 or 4.14.

clauses.section: SECTION 5 LOGISTICS
clauses.text: 5.1 Containers may be either 20GP or 40HQ, at the Subcontractor's option, provided the loading arrangement is approved by the Main Contractor.

gold.notes: Two types allowed: the tool must not pick one silently; approval by the MC is never claimed.

clauses.section: SECTION 5 LOGISTICS
clauses.text: 5.2 All materials shall be delivered in 40-foot containers.

gold.notes: Only a size: 40GP vs 40HQ is not settled by the clause.

clauses.section: SECTION 5 LOGISTICS
clauses.text: 5.3 Container 要求：统一使用 40HQ（高柜），每柜 cargo net weight 不超过 20 吨，不含 A-frame 及 dunnage。

gold.notes: Mixed: 40HQ only; net cargo per container <= 20 t, excluding A-frames (stillages) and dunnage.

clauses.section: SECTION 5 LOGISTICS
clauses.text: 5.4 Open top and flat rack containers shall not be used.

gold.notes: Negated only. Must NOT be read as a request for open top or flat rack; names no permitted type.

clauses.section: SECTION 5 LOGISTICS
clauses.text: 5.5 Container 柜型：20' GP 或 40' GP；因现场入口限高，不接受 high cube 柜。

gold.notes: Mixed: 20GP or 40GP; high cube refused because of the site entrance height limit.

clauses.section: SECTION 5 LOGISTICS
clauses.text: 5.6 20GP containers shall not be used for unitised panels; panels shall travel in 40ft high cube containers only.

gold.notes: Ban plus a positive type: the plan type is 40HQ; '20GP' appears only in the ban.

clauses.section: PART C EMPLOYER'S REQUIREMENTS
clauses.text: Clause 12 Transport of Glazed Units. Oversized glazed canopy units shall be transported on 40ft flat rack containers with weather-proof covers.

gold.notes: Flat rack is special equipment: no plan, person decides. Must not become a 40HQ/40GP plan.

clauses.section: PART C EMPLOYER'S REQUIREMENTS
clauses.text: Clause 13 Long Members. Steel canopy beams exceeding 11.5 m shall be shipped in 40ft open top containers and loaded by crane.

gold.notes: Open top: no plan, person decides.

clauses.section: PART C EMPLOYER'S REQUIREMENTS
clauses.text: Clause 14 Hoisting at Site. The tower crane at the loading bay is rated 3.2 t at 40 m radius; no single lift, including spreader and slings, shall exceed 3,000 kg.

gold.notes: Crane lift limit, not a container limit (3.2 t is the crane rating, not a limit to cite either).

clauses.section: PART C EMPLOYER'S REQUIREMENTS
clauses.text: Clause 15 Site Access. Delivery vehicles entering from Synthetic Avenue shall not exceed 32 tonnes gross vehicle weight; prime movers with 40ft trailers must obtain the Main Contractor's slot booking 48 hours ahead.

gold.notes: Vehicle GVW, not a container limit. '40ft trailers' does not set a container type.

clauses.section: PART C EMPLOYER'S REQUIREMENTS
clauses.text: Clause 16 Delivery Sequence. Panels shall arrive in installation sequence, floor by floor and elevation by elevation, as per the approved installation programme. Each container shall carry panels for one floor only.

gold.notes: A plan can evidence one-floor-per-container only if it shows floor per container.

clauses.section: PART C EMPLOYER'S REQUIREMENTS
clauses.text: Clause 17 Logistics Plan. The Subcontractor shall submit a packing and logistics plan stating container type and number, loading arrangement, weight per container and centre of gravity, securing method and delivery schedule, not later than 4 weeks before the first shipment.

gold.notes: A draft plan is evidence for its contents; submitting it is a person's act.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.15 Insurance: The Subcontractor shall maintain Contractor's All Risks and Work Injury Compensation insurance for the duration of the Subcontract.

gold.notes: Distractor: insurance.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.16 Marine cargo insurance shall cover all materials from the factory to site, including while stored in containers at port, for 110% of the invoice value.

gold.notes: Distractor: insurance that mentions containers; sets no type and no limit.

clauses.section: SECTION 4 PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION - PACKING AND DELIVERY
clauses.text: 4.17 Warranty: 10 years for water tightness and 20 years for the PVDF coating of aluminium; damage in transport does not shorten the warranty period.

gold.notes: Distractor: warranty that mentions transport.
